incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: service=embeds-us-west · symptom=5xx spike · p95 latency 3200ms · traffic x3 above baseline · PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/789012 · runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/embeds

alex: ack'd — taking initial triage, checking recent deploys and logs now.

alex: quick lookup: new rollout about 10m ago (rev=2026-03-10-rc3). Logs from embed-worker show repeated OOMs and stack traces referencing kv-cache allocation.

alex: command I'm running: ```kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embed-worker --tail=100 | grep -i oom```

morgan: thanks. If it's an OOM/scale issue I can jump in for infra remediation; otherwise alex you can hotfix/rollback. I'll standby. @ines can you prep customer-impact messaging? :eyes:

alex: initiating rollback to previous stable revision now: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-worker --to-revision=2026-03-09-stable``` — will post status.

deploy-bot: rollback job started — job id=7890 · rolling update in us-west cluster · ETA ~90s

ben: looking at metrics — autoscaler reacted to a burst and spawned many small pods with default memory limits. Combined memory footprint exceeded node alloc and caused pod restarts. Suggest pinning memory requests/limits and increase node pool temporarily.

ines: I'll take monitoring after rollback finishes and validate KV cache warm-up. @morgan do you want me to coordinate direct pings to the top customers?

morgan: yes please, ping the top 3 affected customers and note we are rolling back a deploy. Draft: "We observed elevated errors for embeddings in us-west starting ~14:30 UTC. A rollback has been applied and we are monitoring recovery. We'll follow up with timeline and a postmortem." Add customer IDs to the PD incident.

alex: rollback completed at 2026-03-10T14:42:18Z · error-rate (5xx) started falling within 30s, p95 latency improving. Logs show OOMs stopped. :white_check_mark:

ines: confirmed — 5xx back to baseline across all pods; KV cache warming, traces look normal. I'll continue a 15m watch and then hand back to next shift.

morgan: assigning postmortem owner: morgan — follow-ups: 1) increase embed-worker memory limit and test under load, 2) add pre-warm for KV cache after deploys, 3) tighten autoscaler scale-up thresholds, 4) add alert that correlates pod OOM restarts with autoscaler bursts. I'll open GH issue and link to PD incident.

ben: adding one more ops item — consider a rolling-deploy gating job that validates memory usage on a canary before full rollout.

alex: on-call handoff: I'm marking this as resolved for now, will leave notes in PD. If anything flares up I'll re-open.

incident-bot: Page resolved · incident PD#789012 closed by alex · summary: rollback of 2026-03-10-rc3 resolved OOM-driven 5xx spike in embeds-us-west · follow-up: https://redwood/reports/incident-789012 · postmortem owner=morgan
